theorems.statement: ∀ (N n : ℕ) (O M : Set (Euclidean N)) (θ : Euclidean N → ℝ) (y : Euclidean N) (P : Submodule ℝ (Euclidean N)), IsOpen O → y ∈ O → (Chapter03.HasWeightedApproximateTangentSpaceAt n (O ∩ M) θ y P ↔ Chapter03.HasWeightedApproximateTangentSpaceAt n M θ y P)
